output.reason: [ev-9113ff586fec] deprecates both the cilium-agent flag `--enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint` and its Helm value `enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint`. It also says the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18. The environments that touch the deprecated option are the ones that set it, either through the agent flag or through the Helm value. The proposed any[cli-flag set, values-key set] condition covers exactly those environments and nothing broader.
